rules.description: Verifies that MaxDate is uniform across all EPA GHGRP parent company emission StatVars.
Verifies that all StatVars reach at least reporting year 2023 (static floor avoids Jan 1 rolling-year false positives due to EPA GHGRP annual reporting lag).

params.query: SELECT COALESCE(MIN(CAST(LEFT(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 4) AS INT)), 0) AS min_max_year FROM stats
